summary: Research competitor activity, find content gaps, and map out a posting plan for the next three months.

useCases.title: Build a 90-day content calendar
useCases.message: Help me build a 90-day content calendar. Ask me which channels to cover and what themes or products I want to promote. You might want to research what competitors are posting and what is performing well in the space before building the plan. Then map out a posting schedule with themes, formats, and priority dates.
